title: The Conformation of the Complementary Strand and the Deformation of the DNA Groove upon DDB2 Binding Justifies the Different Repair Rates for Cyclobutane Pyrimidine Dimers
authors: Yani Kedjar; Cécilia Hognon; Thierry Douki; Elise Dumont; Antonio Monari
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究DDB2蛋白识别不同环丁烷嘧啶二聚体DNA损伤时互补链与DNA沟槽的构象变形差异，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构机制研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合与互作建模。
abstract: The repair of photo-induced DNA lesions through nucleotide excision repair machinery is still the source of important questions. It has been observed that the repair rate of the different cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers, i.e. the photoproducts induced by dimerization of two π-stacked pyrimidines (T<>T, T<>C, C<>T, C<>C), depends on the nucleobases involved in the lesion. TT derivatives (T<>T) are removed more slowly than those containing cytosine, especially in 5’. Using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that the variation of the repair rate observed in human skin and in cultured cutaneous cell may be associated to the recognition of the four lesions by the DDB2 protein moiety, and more specifically by the differential structural deformation induced on the complementary strand and the major groove. These effects may then hamper differentially the downstream recruitment of the repair complexes. The observed DNA deformation correlates with the experimental repair rate and suggests a structural rationale for the different repair rates of CPD by nucleotide excision repair machinery. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: 通过核苷酸切除修复机制修复光诱导DNA损伤仍是重要问题的来源。已观察到不同环丁烷嘧啶二聚体，即两个π-堆叠嘧啶二聚化诱导的光产物（T<>T、T<>C、C<>T、C<>C），其修复速率取决于损伤中涉及的核碱基。TT衍生物（T<>T）的移除速度慢于含胞嘧啶的衍生物，尤其是在5'端。利用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们证明在人皮肤和培养皮肤细胞中观察到的修复速率变化可能与DDB2蛋白部分对这四种损伤的识别有关，更具体地，与互补链和主沟上诱导的差异结构变形有关。这些效应随后可能差异性地阻碍修复复合物的下游招募。观察到的DNA变形与实验修复速率相关，并为核苷酸切除修复机制对CPD不同修复速率提供了结构上的合理解释。图形摘要
